_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

pit_profile.why: 'is a research-based, global biopharmaceutical company. We apply science and our global resources to bring therapies to people that extend and significantly improve their lives through the discovery, development and manufacture of healthcare products' (FY2016 10-K, Item 1); 'Competition from manufacturers of generic drugs is a major challenge for our branded products around the world, and the loss or expiration of intellectual property rights can have a significant adverse effect on our revenues' (Item 1A); 'we can lose the major portion of revenues for that product in a very short period of time'; 'A number of our products are expected to face significantly increased generic competition over the next few years' (Item 1A); 'Many of our prescription pharmaceutical products face competition in the form of branded or generic drugs or biosimilars that treat similar diseases or indications'

classification.quality_note: 'is a research-based, global biopharmaceutical company. We apply science and our global resources to bring therapies to people that extend and significantly improve their lives through the discovery, development and manufacture of healthcare products' (FY2016 10-K, Item 1); 'Competition from manufacturers of generic drugs is a major challenge for our branded products around the world, and the loss or expiration of intellectual property rights can have a significant adverse effect on our revenues' (Item 1A); 'we can lose the major portion of revenues for that product in a very short period of time'; 'A number of our products are expected to face significantly increased generic competition over the next few years' (Item 1A); 'Many of our prescription pharmaceutical products face competition in the form of branded or generic drugs or biosimilars that treat similar diseases or indications'. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; +77% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.24; conservative 2yr -30%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -21.3%/yr (worst year FY07-FY16, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +1.2%/yr (FY17 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +1.2%/yr (FY07-FY16 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +29.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY07-FY16); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: PFE (retrospective, 2017-11-01) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (68.8% downside to Bear $11 / +-9.2% upside to Bull $32) | Adj composite 2.23 vs market 3.47: gap -1.24 [OVERVALUED] | +77% above the EPP floor $20 (17x FY17E $1.17) | Conservative 2-yr case: -29.5% total (-14.7%/yr) | At 30.1x FY17E the 15% hurdle price $47 sits above the BULL case; U.S. revenues +0.1% in Q3 2017, forward revenues -0.8% to +0.5% (FY17 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
